text:
maria: Heads-up: canary promotion for payments-service failed health checks in eu-west after chart v3.4.0 promote. 503s and some pods in CrashLoopBackOff.
deploy-bot: Automated: promotion failed healthgate. Suggested actions: rollback to v3.3.2 or hotpatch image override. See deployctl suggestions.
maria: Crash loops look like an env var change missing from values (DB_CONN_TIMEOUT removed in v3.4.0). Could be values drift. We rolled new config into chart, but values didn't merge.
infra: Confirmed PVCs and nodes healthy. This looks strictly config mismatch. If we rollback chart we lose some feature flags we wanted to test. Can we hotpatch with the old values via rollout patch?
sam: Hotpatch approach: patch the HelmRelease to inject the missing value via a temporary values override, then re-trigger rollout. That avoids full rollback and keeps chart version anchored.
sre-oncall: Risk: if underlying image also contains changes, hotpatch may mask a real regression. We should snapshot current replicaset and take a quick canary probe before applying global patch.
deploy-bot: Guidance: `deployctl suggest srvc-payments --actions` -> recommends: `rollback --to v3.3.2` or `rollout patch --set values.temp.db_conn_timeout=30s` with note about automated rollback TTL.
maria: I prefer hotpatch to avoid reverting chart version. Plan: 1) take snapshot `kubectl get rs -lapp=payments -o yaml > rs-snap-2801234567.yaml` 2) apply temp values override: `kubectl annotate helmrelease payments-service release.redwood/temp-override=rs-2801234567 --overwrite` and create a kustomize patch `patch-values.yaml` 3) `deployctl rollout patch payments-service --values-file=patch-values.yaml` 4) monitor healthgate for 10m.
infra: Make sure to include approver annotation for audit. Also add a release-note line so rollout history is clear.
sam: Example patch-values.yaml snippet we used before: ```yaml
spec:
  values:
    db_conn_timeout: "30s"
    feature_x_enabled: false
```
sre-oncall: Approving manual hotpatch: sre-oncall. I'll watch error budgets and be ready to trigger rollback if spikes worsen.
deploy-bot: Note: Manual rollout patch detected. Automated rollback will not be triggered for 30m TTL when a `release.redwood/temp-override` annotation is present. To revert override use `kubectl annotate helmrelease payments-service release.redwood/temp-override-` and `deployctl rollout resume` if paused.
maria: Applying patch now. `kubectl apply -f patch-values.yaml` then `deployctl rollout patch payments-service --values-file=patch-values.yaml`
sam: Added release-note: "temporary values override applied to supply db_conn_timeout after chart values drift in v3.4.0; will revert if automated tests fail or after canary completes."
infra: INFRA-3001 created to audit values-merge pipeline and ensure future chart bumps validate values merge.
sre-oncall: Monitoring live. Health probes show steady improvement at +4m. Error rate down from 6% -> 1.2%. Keep observing to +12m.
maria: If stable at +10m we keep the override and tag it in release notes as a short-term mitigation. We'll follow up with a proper values fix in next patch release.
sam: If things degrade, rollback command is `deployctl rollback payments-service --revision v3.3.2` (requires approver annotation).
deploy-bot: Audit: manual hotpatch performed by maria at 2801234567; annotation recorded. TTL for suppression until 2801237567 (30m).
maria: Will update changelog and notify #product-notifications with the short blurb. Closing thread unless we need to rollback. :thumbsup:
